text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... No matter how much I eat, it 
just won't go away~!

The group continued working hard on making 
ramen! However, no matter what they did, 
they ended up with too many leftover 
prototypes...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I overboiled the noodles. But it couldn't 
be helped. Practicing noodle-draining 
motions in the air is no substitute for 
the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I ended up making way too many toppings 
myself. And here I thought I had endless 
room in my stomach for ramen."
choice_data_list: Hmm, this is quite a pickle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes... but I have no choice but to push 
through and finish eating!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuuuuu~! I'll do my b-besht, I will~~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, whoa, hold on. Don't push yourself 
too hard~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let's put our own spin on this. Leave it 
to Nature-san~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho-hop... and there.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sauce smells amazing! Is that 
okonomiyaki with noodles in it...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see, modan-yaki! It's so chewy and 
delicious. Nature-chan really is handy at 
cooking.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You can freeze these, right? Whenever 
you're hungry, just microwave 'em and eat 
right away. Everyone, take some home~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
For the chashu and eggs... I could chop 
them finely with mayo, maybe. Turn it into 
a dip, or use it as a filling for gratin.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That's a nice twist. I'll put it on sliced 
bread and freeze it. Just toasting it in 
the morning will make a lavish breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaah~~! With this, everyone should be 
able to finish their food!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Nature-san really is amazing, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I mean...! At times like this, you always 
just whip up a fix like it's nothing, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually... I've thought you were 
amazing since a little while ago.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
When we ran the stall, you worked so 
briskly and covered up so many of my 
clumsy mistakes...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san is the complete opposite of me— 
she's so resourceful and quick-witted...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? I'm just used 
to it. I dealt with leftovers all the time 
at my family's shop.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and this is exactly what I mean...! 
She's always so humble just so she doesn't 
make those around her feel 
self-conscious...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that how you're interpreting it? 
I-It's really not that big of a deal, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! I really admire it too. 
Because it was just like magic♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Not you too, Fine-san! No, this is really 
just a commoner's little life hack, so to 
speak...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I think so too! That's amazing! Modifying 
a recipe on the fly like that is no easy 
feat!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, so blinding...! No, no, that's really 
not...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ah~! What should I do about the 
bamboo shoots? Let me go think about it 
for a bit~~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawawaa, Nature-saaan...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
She ran off. Just trying to hide her 
embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-N-N-No way... When I haven't even 
praised you nearly enough...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I won't give up until I get my feelings 
across to yooouuuu!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder if Nature-chan will let me 
catch her today? She always runs away 
whenever I praise her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That is very typical of Nature-chan. 
Still, it's a little frustrating, isn't 
it?

Hearing those words, I couldn't help but 
nod deeply. It seems it will take more 
time for her to honestly accept praise and 
admiration...!
